notes.title: Update from 0.30 to .32
notes.content:
Update from 0.30 to .32

Found a minor bug last minute so here are 2 builds at once!


Build 0.31 + 0.32

Changes:

Added: New level
Added: Multiple new soundtracks

Fixed: Scraps gain / craft cost display 
Fixed: Scraps gain / craft cost formula 
Fixed: A bug occuring when flipping from the last to the first page in the crafting menu


Hope you like it!

Have a great day!

notes.title: Update to Build 0.930
notes.content:
Updated to Build 0.930

Fixed color change for ability buttons when selected.

Added a new superpower: Super Ripple.

Fine-tuned projectile knockback mechanics.

Hide cursor settings are now saved, with 'Off' saved as 'Auto' to prevent loss of control.

Composed and added extra music tracks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45470846/1894b7889e629bd6b9719495fb9438944d863d07.png[/img]

notes.title: Store & Builds Approved!
notes.content:
I am excited to bring you the first announcement!

The store got approved!

The first version of the game got approved!
- Version 0.929 - Windows
- Version 0.929 - Linux
- Version 0.929 - Mac

I expect to release the game on:
14 Feb, 2025


Have a great day!
